# Test fixtures

- `plain.zip` — unencrypted; files `a.txt` (`hello\n`), `nested/b.pdf` (tiny `%PDF-1.1`), `c.bin` (`\x00\x01\x02`). Generated by the test ZipCrypto writer (deflate + stored).
- `encrypted-secret.zip` — same files, traditional ZipCrypto, password `secret`. Independently readable with Python `zipfile.read(..., pwd=b"secret")`.
- `aes-method99.zip` / `aes-extra.zip` — local-header stubs that must throw `AES zip not supported`.
